memories.title: 首页接口重复因onMounted与绑房回跳并发
memories.content: 根因：H5首次进入时`onShow`与`onMounted`均触发`loadPageData()`，且绑房回跳时`handleLingxiHouseBind`内`syncHouseInfoAfterLogin`已拉取房屋/小区，首页未等待绑房结束并行请求致接口重复。修复：`newHome.vue`中H5首次仅由`onMounted`加载并跳过首次`onShow`；新增`waitForLingxiHouseBind()`使`loadPageData`等待绑房完成，store已有数据时跳过`getMyHouseList`/`getProjectList`；`lingxi.js`与`newHome.vue`添加`[灵锡绑房回跳]`/`[newHome]`的authCode日志。
